scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one landscape inline illustration for chapter 5 of a graded Japanese reader.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved Kasa Jizō inline style reference only. Image 2 is the Kagefumi series cover for Haru and Sora's character identity and palette only.
Primary request: Illustrate the moment Sora stamps on his own shadow at Mamoru's feet, helping it slide back to him on the shrine steps at sunset.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet flight of broad old stone steps leading uphill toward a small shrine. A narrow warm-red beam of late sunlight falls across a few steps beneath a cloudy sky.
Subject: Sora, a small boy with short dark hair, a light grey shirt and dark shorts, stamps with both feet on a separate dark shadow stretched across the step near Mamoru. The shadow is just beginning to slide back toward Sora's own feet, like a low ribbon of dark water. Mamoru is a slight hatless boy on the higher step, watching calmly. Haru, a slightly older girl with a long dark ponytail and muted teal clothes, stands to one side holding a small old photograph and a plain straw hat. Their elderly grandmother watches nearby with a walking stick, wearing simple muted plum and sage clothes. Keep the group legible and the emotion quiet.
Style/medium: Follow Image 1's approved inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background. Use Image 2 only for Haru and Sora's identity and palette; keep detail simpler than the cover.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape close to 12:7. Three depth layers at most. The children, two separate shadows and the sunlit steps are the clear focal elements; natural proportions and simple readable poses.
Lighting/mood: Soft overcast dusk with one restrained stripe of red-gold sunlight, tender and quietly magical.
Color palette: Warm stone, muted teal, soft grey, sage, plum, dark warm brown and subdued red-gold.
Constraints: Depict only this paragraph's action, with the shadow in motion but not yet visibly merged with Sora's. No legible marks or writing on the photo, no captions, lettering, border, watermark, decorative frame or later-story events.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a quiet landscape inline painting for chapter 5, “The Third Sunset,” in a graded Japanese reader.
Input images: Images 1–3 are the approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings and define only the simpler inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture and quiet backgrounds. Image 4 guides Haru and Sora’s character identity and palette only. Image 5 guides the family’s character identities and colours only, not its composition or detailed rendering.
Primary request: depict paragraph 1: Grandma climbs the shrine steps slowly beneath heavy clouds while Haru and Sora support her from either side.
Scene/backdrop: a modest Japanese hilltop shrine approached by a broad, old stone staircase. Under a low cloudy evening sky, the steps look darker than usual. Keep the shrine, mountain and surroundings as a few spare shapes.
Subject: exactly three people. Their elderly Japanese grandmother, with grey hair in a small bun and simple muted plum and sage clothing, climbs one step at a time using her wooden walking stick. Haru, a slightly older girl with long dark hair tied back and muted teal clothes, supports one arm; Sora, a small boy with short dark hair, a pale grey shirt and dark shorts, supports the other. Show their careful, steady movement and their arms linked with Grandma. No other people.
Style/medium: children’s picture-book gouache in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, and a quiet simplified background. Detail simpler than the chapter cover.
Composition/framing: wide landscape close to 12:7, the three figures large and easy to read on a few simple step bands, with the walking stick and supportive arms clear. Keep a calm open area around them.
Lighting/mood: subdued overcast dusk, tender, determined and quiet.
Color palette: warm stone grey, muted teal, plum, sage, ivory and restrained blue-grey.
Constraints: show only this moment before the boy appears. No Mamoru, no straw-hat boy, no extra shadows or supernatural effects. No text, lettering, signs, numbers, border, watermark or decorative frame.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: simple landscape inline story painting for chapter 5, “The Third Sunset,” in a graded Japanese reader.
Input images: Images 1–3 are the approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings and define only their simpler treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture and quiet backgrounds. Image 4 guides Haru and Sora’s identity and palette only. Image 5 guides the family’s character identities and clothing colours only; do not copy its detailed rendering or composition.
Primary request: depict paragraph 5: a narrow break opens in the clouds and one beam of red evening light falls on the shrine steps, with three long shadows stretching uphill.
Scene/backdrop: a small Japanese hilltop shrine above a mountain town. Show only a few broad stone step bands, a simple shrine roof silhouette, one mountain shape and a heavy, smooth blue-grey cloud mass with a narrow opening. The setting sun sits on the mountain beyond the gap.
Subject: at the lower steps stand exactly four figures: Haru in muted teal, little Sora in pale grey, their elderly grandmother in plum and sage with her wooden walking stick, and the young hatless Mamoru in plain muted clothes. Keep their figures small and calm so the beam and shadows read first. Haru carries the plain straw hat and old photo. Exactly three long natural cast shadows stretch uphill from Haru, Sora and Grandma. Mamoru has no separate shadow. No extra shadow shapes.
Style/medium: children’s picture-book gouache in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: large broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, and a quiet simplified background. Keep the scene much simpler than the chapter cover. Use only a few stone bands; no mottled or engraved stone, dense foliage, tiny marks or intricate architecture.
Composition/framing: wide landscape near 12:7, with the three long shadows clearly separated across broad simple steps and a single diagonal red-gold beam crossing them. Keep the four figures readable but secondary.
Lighting/mood: overcast dusk interrupted by one restrained red-gold shaft, hushed and quietly hopeful.
Color palette: muted blue-grey, stone grey, warm ivory, muted teal, sage, plum and restrained red-gold.
Constraints: exactly four people and exactly three shadows. Show the still moment only; no one steps on, touches or retrieves a shadow. No shadow moves out of the photograph, no restored shadow, no hat on Mamoru’s head, no later-story events. No text, lettering, signs, numbers, border, watermark or decorative frame.
